# Identifier

A typed external identifier. Use 'system' to namespace identifiers and prevent collisions across jurisdictions and organisations

Source: [`v3/common/identifier.json`](../../../v3/common/identifier.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/identifier.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `system` | `string` | | Namespace URI or name identifying the issuing authority or system. Use URN format where possible for unambiguous identification |
| `value` | `string` | yes | The identifier value itself. Format depends on the system — may include hyphens, spaces, or check digits as appropriate |
| `type` | `string` | | Human-readable type label describing what kind of identifier this is |
